title: Special Drug Use-results Survey for Long-term Use（Avacopan）
off: Special Drug Use-results Survey for Long-term Use
summary: The purpose of this survey is evaluating the safety and efficacy of long-term administration of avacopan for Japanese patients with microscopic polyangiitis or granulomatosis with polyangiitis under actual conditions of use.
desc: The purpose of this survey is evaluating the safety and efficacy of long-term administration of avacopan for Japanese patients with microscopic polyangiitis or granulomatosis with polyangiitis under actual conditions of use.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis who are treatment with avacopan
